Crooked

Biography

Crooked is hostile to Kir and Kel and accuses them of spying. The investigation ultimately exposes his theft from the settlement’s common funds. In his confession he admits killing Brissen after the knight discovered it, planting the stolen knife and killing His to prevent their dealings from being revealed. [1, 2, 3, 4]
